name: assisted oblique glute minimus and medius stretch
description: A partner-assisted stretch for the outer hip and side of the trunk. It eases tightness in the small gluteal muscles and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back or side while your partner supports your top leg.
Have your partner gently guide the leg across your body while you stay relaxed.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
